01 / THE GATHERING

Multiple days.
Twenty seats.
One fire.

Creator Growth ATL is the live, in-person arm of the 19Keys Creator Growth Program — a working mastermind for creators, founders, and builders held on a private ten-acre estate. 19Keys leads the room. The estate does the rest: sessions under the pavilion, content across the grounds, and the kind of conversations that only happen when the right twenty people share one table.

You leave with a sharpened plan, a content bank shot on the property, and a room that keeps compounding after you drive off.

Led by 19Keys

00 / HOW WE STARTED

The room already proved it.

InvestFest week, August 2026: a six-night residency at Peace on the Pond and the 19Keys — Creator Growth Mastermind Atlanta on August 10. A $2,500 partnership investment carried by six deliverables — the endorsement film, the booking funnel, the consultations, the content library, and a commitment to keep building.

The energy in that room is the product. This partnership turns it into a standing series.

Peace on the Pond calls itself a serene sanctuary of renewal, built for thought leaders and healers — a place for single-day retreats and multi-day challenges alike. That is exactly the room 19Keys wants to build inside: a turnkey estate where the details are handled and the work is transformation.

Straight talk on the content: the InvestFest footage is still landing — that first shoot was pulled together last-minute with outside hands that weren't the right fit, so it moved slower than it should have. The full gallery goes live here by Sunday: the InvestFest drive. Every event from here runs on our own content team and systems, so the media is handled right, start to finish — because the whole operation is set up properly before we ever walk in.

InvestFest · Atlanta
01 / THE VISION

A standing series, not a one-off.

Flexible 3–5 day window, always scheduled around existing POTP bookings.

On pricing: a single day on the estate is an experience — that runs at $555. A multi-day camp is a transformation, and the way 19Keys designed it to be run — that carries the $2,500 Creator Camp seat. The property's own model already speaks this language: single-day retreats and multi-day challenges, side by side.

On cadence: High Lvl runs a Creator Growth event every month as part of the program, travel included. We anticipate bringing five to six of those to Peace on the Pond across the year — not every month — always scheduled for windows the property confirms open. The property's calendar comes first; the series works around it.

02 / THE NUMBERS

Profitable at ten seats.

These projections are built conservatively — a modest room of ten, no sponsor assumed. Everything above this is upside, and Peace on the Pond shares in all of it.

Per-event economics — conservative base

LineAmount
Creator Camp tuition — 10 seats × $2,500$25,000
Travel & team logistics($2,000)
Media & content production($5,000)
Guest experience — practitioners, food & beverage, on-site production($1,500)

Ten seats is the planning number, not the ceiling. A fuller room lifts every figure below it — and the property's share rises with it.

Peace on the Pond earns a $2,500 minimum every event, then 25% of net profit above it — so a conservative ten-seat room already returns roughly $4,125, well past the guarantee, plus a full professional content drop each visit. The stronger the room, the more the property earns. A single $7,500 sponsor, when we land one, is pure upside on top.

03 / THE SPLIT

Simple enough to say yes to.

STEP 01
Costs recovered
Event operating costs are recovered first — travel, media & content production, and the guest experience.
STEP 02
$2,500 floor
Peace on the Pond is guaranteed a $2,500 minimum every event, regardless of how the room fills.
STEP 03
25% of profit
Above the floor, the property earns 25% of net profit — a true share of the upside, never counted seat by seat.

The guarantee is the floor, not the expectation. On a conservative ten-seat room, Peace on the Pond earns roughly $4,125 — already well above the minimum — plus a full professional content drop from every visit, with none of the booking or marketing work. As the room grows, so does the property's share. The stronger we perform, the more Peace on the Pond takes home.

04 / DELIVERABLES

What each side brings.

High Lvl × 19Keys

  • AVA voice agent — a 24/7 automated agent (callava.ai) on our account, answering POTP calls and capturing bookings.
  • Creator Growth inclusion — Crystal in the room: the conversations, the guests, the network, every gathering.
  • 19Keys booking funnel — a dedicated affiliate link; Keys promotes the property to his network and earns on every referred booking.
  • AI lead-gen engine — built by Antoine Digital: finds POTP's ideal clients and helps book the contracts.
  • The content team — our crew shoots the whole camp for us, and sells paid individual content packages to attendees. The property gets a fresh professional drop from every visit.
  • Full-service media for the property — when other leaders bring their own events to Peace on the Pond, our media people can run the entire production. We manage the whole process end to end, turning the estate into a turnkey venue that sells itself on the content.
  • Ziion listing & 10% affiliate — the property listed on Ziion, our booking platform, with a dedicated affiliate code earning 10% on referred bookings. As we put serious marketing behind Ziion, our 25,000-plus community and email list get Peace on the Pond as a featured resource, and Crystal comes on as a recognized leader on the platform.

Peace on the Pond

  • The estate — a standing Southeast home for the series at a true partner rate.
  • Wellness curation — sauna, ice plunge, Shala, labyrinth, sound — the modalities that make the day unforgettable.
  • The calendar — a protected 3–5 day window each cycle, worked around existing bookings.
  • The network — the real-estate world, the NAREB bridge, and Atlanta itself.
